properties.thermal_conductivity: Moderate-to-high for a structural metal; strongly grade/process/temperature dependent.
properties.specific_heat: Requires temperature-specific evidence for high-accuracy thermal models.
properties.cte: High relative to steels; dimensional calculations should retain alloy and temperature context.
properties.melting_range: Alloy-specific; use specification/manufacturer data rather than a universal magnesium value.
properties.thermal_diffusivity: Derive only from compatible conductivity, density and specific-heat datasets.
properties.emissivity: Surface-condition and temperature dependent; do not use an unqualified universal value.

engineering_rules: Thermal properties are not interchangeable between pure Mg and Mg alloys.
Thermal expansion can be significant in precision assemblies and dissimilar-material joints.
For transient thermal analysis, retain temperature dependence where it materially affects the result.
For fire or severe overheating scenarios, treat magnesium as a specific hazard case rather than ordinary metallic material.
